review_candidates.title: Account Manager
review_candidates.description: Senior Client Relations Specialist Are you an experienced client relations or account management professional who knows how to build strong relationships, resolve challenges, and identify opportunities for account growth? Join KALAM as a Senior Client Relations Specialist and take ownership of a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary link between them and our internal teams. You will play a key role in strengthening client satisfaction, supporting retention and renewals, managing escalations, and identifying opportunities to expand our partnerships. About the Role As a Senior Client Relations Specialist, you will manage the day-to-day relationship with assigned clients and develop a strong understanding of their business, priorities, expectations, and evolving needs. This role goes beyond responding to client requests. You will proactively monitor account health, identify potential risks, coordinate the resolution of service issues, support renewals, and uncover opportunities for account growth. You will work closely with Operations, Service Delivery, Quality, Finance, Business Development, Technology, and other internal teams to ensure client commitments are clearly communicated and effectively delivered. Key Responsibilities Client Relationship & Portfolio Management Own the day-to-day relationship for an assigned portfolio of clients. Act as the primary coordination point between clients and KALAM's internal teams. Develop a deep understanding of each client's business, operating model, requirements, priorities, and contractual commitments. Build trusted professional relationships with stakeholders at different organizational levels. Maintain proactive and regular communication with clients. Ensure clients receive accurate, professional, consistent, and timely communication. Monitor overall account health and proactively identify potential risks and opportunities. Client Experience & Retention Monitor client satisfaction and the overall client experience across assigned accounts. Identify early signs of dissatisfaction, service concerns, relationship deterioration, or potential churn. Coordinate proactive actions with internal teams before issues escalate. Support client retention and renewal activities. Gather, document, and communicate client feedback to relevant stakeholders. Help strengthen relationships that position KALAM as a trusted long-term business partner. Complaint & Escalation Management Own client complaints and escalations from acknowledgment through resolution and closure. Assess issue urgency, severity, and business impact. Coordinate with Operations, Service Delivery, Quality, Finance, Technology, and other relevant teams to resolve issues. Keep clients informed throughout the resolution process. Follow up on agreed actions and ensure commitments are completed. Support root-cause analysis to help prevent recurring issues. Escalate major relationship, service, contractual, or financial risks when required. Account Growth & Commercial Opportunities Identify potential opportunities for account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, and additional services. Understand changing client requirements and translate them into potential business opportunities. Qualify potential opportunities before escalating them to the Senior Client Relations Manager and/or Business Development team. Provide relevant client and account intelligence to support opportunity development. Coordinate internally to confirm operational feasibility before commitments are made. Support proposals, renewals, and account expansion discussions. Maintain ownership of the overall client relationship while senior management or Business Development leads final commercial negotiations. Renewals & Contract Support Monitor upcoming contract renewals and begin preparations well in advance. Review client satisfaction, account performance, risks, outstanding issues, and potential growth opportunities before renewal discussions. Coordinate required information with internal stakeholders. Support renewal negotiations and discussions. Ensure agreed contractual changes and client commitments are clearly communicated internally. Financial & Collection Support Maintain awareness of the financial status of assigned client accounts. Coordinate with Finance regarding overdue invoices and collection priorities. Follow up professionally with clients regarding outstanding balances. Escalate payment disputes, recurring collection issues, or financial risks when needed. Coordinate with Finance to resolve client queries related to invoices. Client Intelligence & Forecasting Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on assigned accounts. Track changes in client demand, expected volumes, service requirements, business conditions, and expansion plans. Share relevant client insights with Operations, Planning & Control, Finance, Business Development, and other stakeholders. Support operational and commercial forecasting through timely client intelligence. Identify relevant market or competitor information obtained through client interactions. Cross-Functional Coordination Collaborate closely with Service Delivery, Operations, Planning & Control, Quality, Finance, Business Development, Technology, and other departments. Translate client requirements into clear and actionable internal information. Ensure internal stakeholders understand client priorities and commitments. Coordinate cross-functional actions related to assigned accounts. Follow up on delays, gaps, conflicting information, or unresolved actions that may affect the client relationship. Ensure external commitments remain aligned with KALAM's operational capabilities. Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Experience 3–4 years of relevant professional experience. At least 2–3 years of experience in Client Relations, Account Management, Customer Success, Service Delivery, BPO, or a similar client-facing role. Proven experience managing multiple client accounts or stakeholder relationships simultaneously. Previous experience within BPO, outsourcing, interpretation, contact centers, customer experience, or professional services is highly preferred. Key Competencies Client Relationship Management Account Management Customer Success & Retention Complaint & Escalation Management Stakeholder Management Cross-Functional Coordination Business Development & Account Growth Negotiation & Commercial Awareness Problem Solving Communication & Presentation Skills Client Reporting & Account Intelligence Time Management & Prioritization Why Join KALAM? KALAM provides language and business-process solutions to organizations across international markets, with services covering areas such as remote interpretation, customer experience management, shared services, and digital CX. If you are passionate about building strong client partnerships, solving complex challenges, and contributing to long-term account growth, we would like to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Mid / Senior Backend Engineer (Golang, Kubernetes, GCP)
review_candidates.description: Products: Abraxa Agency (Abraxa.com) & Laytime.com Industry: Maritime Tech / B2B SaaS / Applied AI Level: Mid-Level to Senior Location: Sofia / Varna, Bulgaria / Hybrid / Remote Employment Type: Full-Time About Us: Building the Digital Backbone of Global Shipping Global trade moves by sea, yet the maritime industry still relies heavily on fragmented systems, manual processes, and legacy workflows. At Abraxa Agency and Laytime.com , we are modernizing maritime operations from the ground up. Abraxa.com is the leading port call optimization and collaboration platform designed specifically for port agents, principals, and maritime stakeholders—bringing real-time transparency and automation to port operations. Laytime.com is revolutionizing how the shipping industry calculates laytime and demurrage, turning complex charter parties, Statements of Facts (SOFs), and voyage events into streamlined, AI-powered workflows. As our platform usage and AI capabilities scale rapidly, we are looking for an experienced Mid to Senior Backend Engineer who writes idiomatic, high-performance Go (Golang) and is comfortable taking ownership of our cloud infrastructure on Kubernetes (K8s) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . The Role We are looking for a seasoned builder who takes ownership of systems from architectural design all the way to production reliability. In this role, you will architect, build, and scale the core backend services and APIs that power Abraxa and Laytime . Because we operate as a lean, high-impact engineering team, you will also own the bridge between backend code and cloud infrastructure—containerizing services with Docker , orchestrating workloads on GKE (Kubernetes) , and evolving our GCP environment. You will also work closely with our Data & AI engineering team to productionize high-throughput data pipelines and LLM-powered microservices, ensuring our platforms remain fast, resilient, and secure under heavy workloads. What You Will Be Doing High-Performance Backend Architecture: Design, build, and maintain concurrent, scalable microservices and APIs primarily in Golang , powering complex maritime workflows (port calls, financial disbursement accounts, automated laytime calculations, and real-time vessel integrations). Cloud & Kubernetes Operations: Package services using Docker and manage deployments, auto-scaling, networking, and service reliability on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) . GCP Infrastructure Management: Architect and optimize our Google Cloud Platform footprint (e.g., GKE, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, IAM) with a focus on security, observability, and cost-efficiency. Database Design & Tuning: Design clean schemas, optimize complex queries, and manage data persistence across relational databases (PostgreSQL) and caching/messaging layers (Redis, Pub/Sub). AI & Data Productionization: Partner with our Data/AI Engineers to integrate LLM inference services, RAG pipelines, and asynchronous background workers seamlessly into our core product architecture. Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Drive best practices in CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and system observability, while mentoring junior and mid-level engineers across the team. What We Are Looking For Must-Haves: 3–6+ years of professional experience in Backend Software Engineering, building and operating production-grade distributed systems or B2B SaaS platforms. Strong proficiency in Go (Golang): Deep understanding of Go idioms, concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels), memory management, and building clean REST/gRPC APIs (or strong experience in another compiled/backend language with proven production experience in Go). Production Kubernetes (K8s) & Docker Experience: Hands-on experience writing optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles, managing Kubernetes workloads (Deployments, StatefulSets, Ingress, Helm, resource limits), and debugging live cluster issues. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise: Solid practical experience deploying, scaling, and securing infrastructure on GCP, particularly around GKE and managed database/messaging services. Database & Messaging Mastery: Strong command of PostgreSQL (indexing, query optimization, transactions) and experience with event-driven architectures (GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Redis). Pragmatic Ownership: You prefer simple, maintainable solutions over over-engineered abstractions, and you care deeply about uptime, latency, and observability. Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or Pulumi. Familiarity with observability and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, GCP Cloud Operations). Secondary experience with Python (helpful when collaborating with our AI/ML and data pipeline services). Prior experience in maritime tech, logistics, supply chain, or fintech (zero maritime domain knowledge is required on day one—we will teach you the industry inside and out). Why Join Us? True Architectural Impact: As a Mid/Senior engineer, your decisions will directly shape how our backend and GCP infrastructure scale across both Abraxa and Laytime . Modern, Bloat-Free Tech Stack: Write clean Go code, run cloud-native workloads on GKE, and help bring advanced AI capabilities into a massive, real-world global industry. High Autonomy, Zero Red Tape: Work in a fast-moving product environment where engineers talk directly to domain experts and ship meaningful features every week. Competitive Compensation

review_candidates.description: About the role We are looking for an AI-native Forward Development Engineer with hands-on expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and React, who can build and enhance scalable services and user-centric web applications for large-scale public health and governance platforms. By AI-native, we mean an engineer who treats AI as a core part of how software is designed, built, tested, and shipped. The engineer should use AI coding assistants and workflows to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment to review, validate, and take ownership of the delivered work. The role involves contributing across backend services and APIs, responsive web applications, reusable components, and automated tests. Strong problem-solving, design thinking, willingness to learn, and the ability to understand user needs and turn them into simple, maintainable solutions are important. Key Roles and Responsibilities Contribute to end-to-end delivery of assigned features — from understanding requirements and solution design through development, testing, and release. Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java / Spring Boot, following established architecture and coding standards. Build and enhance responsive, user-centric web applications using React. Apply design thinking by understanding citizen and government user needs, asking clarifying questions, prototyping where useful, and iterating toward effective solutions. Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) for implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation; review and validate generated output before use. Follow approved architecture, coding standards, security practices, and engineering guidelines. Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality. Build and maintain reusable UI components, services, and utilities. Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering team members. Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to unit and integration tests. Seek feedback, share knowledge, and learn from senior engineers and peers. Contribute to improving engineering practices and responsible AI-assisted development. Required Skills & Experience Core Requirements Education qualification - Bachelor’s degree in any field, with IT experience. 2–3 years of overall software development experience. Hands-on experience in software or product development; SaaS / platform products are an advantage. Interest in and practical use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), with willingness to validate their output carefully. Problem-solving mindset and ability to understand requirements and break them into manageable tasks. Ability to learn quickly, take feedback, and work through technical challenges. Exposure to Agile / Scrum ways of working. Hands-on exposure to Git and tools such as Docker, Jenkins, or Postman. Understanding of responsive web design and web application fundamentals. Backend – Java / Spring Boot (Primary Skill) 2–3 years of strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot . Understanding of REST API design, API contracts, and basic microservices concepts. Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL; familiarity with NoSQL is an advantage. Basic understanding of authentication and authorization; exposure to OAuth2, JWT, or Keycloak is a plus. Exposure to messaging systems such as Kafka is a plus. Understanding of unit and integration testing; exposure to JUnit and Mockito is beneficial. Ability to read, debug, and enhance an existing codebase with guidance. Frontend – React (Secondary Skill) 2+ years hands-on experience building or maintaining web interfaces with ReactJS. Working knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3. Exposure to state management approaches such as Redux, Context API, React Query, or Custom Hooks. Familiarity with NPM and package dependency management. Understanding of reusable components and basic frontend design patterns. Good to have: TypeScript, Webpack, Babel, CSS preprocessors, or Micro-Frontend architecture. AI-Native Engineering Use AI coding assistants to support day-to-day implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. Write clear prompts and break work into small, well-defined tasks for AI assistants. Review AI-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and suitability; remain accountable for code submitted. Exposure to LLM APIs, RAG, or agentic frameworks is a strong plus. Design Thinking & Collaboration Show empathy for users and translate user needs into practical technical solutions. Be comfortable asking questions, prototyping, gathering feedback, and iterating. Communicate clearly with product, design, QA, and engineering colleagues and explain technical decisions when needed.
